inputs.text: ABU DHABI, February 17, 2026 (WAM) – The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued a weather warning regarding potential fog formation and significantly reduced horizontal visibility across several western regions of the UAE. According to the NCM statement released on Tuesday, visibility is expected to deteriorate—and may drop to zero at times—starting from 21:30 tonight until 10:00 AM Wednesday, February 18. The Center has urged motorists to exercise extreme caution on the roads. Drivers are advised to follow all traffic safety guidelines, maintain a safe distance from other vehicles, and strictly adhere to modified speed limits, particularly in areas experiencing thick fog.

fields.description: Fog warning: visibility may drop to zero at times in western regions from 21:30 tonight (Tue 17 Feb) until 10:00 AM Wednesday 18 Feb. Source: National Center for Meteorology.
fields.headline: Fog warning: visibility may drop to zero in western regions tonight until 10:00 Wednesday
fields.instruction: Drive with extreme caution, keep a safe distance from other vehicles and follow modified speed limits in thick fog. More info: https://alerts.example.ae
fields.note_for_reviewer: I chose severity Moderate because the source calls the fog potential, but visibility near zero on roads could justify Severe. Please also confirm that the operator's demo Western zone matches NCM's 'several western regions', since the source does not name specific areas.

Keep the hazard, area, end time and action, and drop the detailed start date and the source line if needed. If the Arabic cannot carry the hazard and action within one page, a person must decide whether a multi-page Arabic message is acceptable.

Arabic is 192 UCS-2 characters, which makes 5 pages at 82 octets (about 41 characters) per page. Handsets may display only part of the alert, or display it fragmented.
